H1732: David, the youngest son of Jesse
H1961: to exist, i.e. be or become, come to pass (always emphatic, and not a mere copula or auxiliary)
H8605: intercession, supplication; by implication, a hymn
H413: near, with or among; often in general, to
H3068: Jehovah, Jewish national name of God
H2199: to shriek (from anguish or danger); by analogy, (as a herald) to announce or convene publicly
H2603: properly, to bend or stoop in kindness to an inferior; to favor, bestow; causatively to implore (i.e. move to favor by petition)
H8210: to spill forth (blood, a libation, liquid metal; or even a solid, i.e. to mound up); also (figuratively) to expend (life, soul, complaint, money, etc.); intensively, to sprawl out
H6440: the face (as the part that turns); used in a great variety of applications (literally and figuratively); also (with prepositional prefix) as a preposition (before, etc.)
H7879: a contemplation; by implication, an utterance
H6869: tightness (i.e. figuratively, trouble); transitively, a female rival:
H5046: properly, to front, i.e. stand boldly out opposite; by implication (causatively), to manifest; figuratively, to announce (always by word of mouth to one present); specifically, to expose, predict, explain, praise
H5848: to shroud, i.e. clothe (whether transitive or reflex.); hence (from the idea of darkness) to languish
H5921: above, over, upon, or against (yet always in this last relation with a downward aspect) in a great variety of applications
H7307: wind; by resemblance breath, i.e. a sensible (or even violent) exhalation; figuratively, life, anger, unsubstantiality; by extension, a region of the sky; by resemblance spirit, but only of a rational being (including its expression and functions)
H859: thou and thee, or (plural) ye and you
H3045: to know (properly, to ascertain by seeing); used in a great variety of senses, figuratively, literally, euphemistically and inferentially (including observation, care, recognition; and causatively, instruction, designation, punishment, etc.)
H734: a well-trodden road (literally or figuratively); also a caravan
H1980: to walk (in a great variety of applications, literally and figuratively)
H6341: a (metallic) sheet (as pounded thin); also a spring net (as spread out like a lamina)
H5027: to scan, i.e. look intently at; by implication, to regard with pleasure, favor or care
H3225: the right hand or side (leg, eye) of a person or other object (as the stronger and more dexterous); locally, the south
H7200: to see, literally or figuratively (in numerous applications, direct and implied, transitive, intransitive and causative)
H369: a non-entity; generally used as a negative particle
H5234: properly, to scrutinize, i.e. look intently at; hence (with recognition implied), to acknowledge, be acquainted with, care for, respect, revere, or (with suspicion implied), to disregard, ignore, be strange toward, reject, resign, dissimulate (as if ignorant or disowning)
H6: properly, to wander away, i.e. lose oneself; by implication to perish (causative, destroy)
H4498: a retreat (literally or figuratively); abstractly, a fleeing
H4480: properly, a part of; hence (prepositionally), from or out of in many senses
H1875: properly, to tread or frequent; usually to follow (for pursuit or search); by implication, to seek or ask; specifically to worship
H5315: properly, a breathing creature, i.e. animal of (abstractly) vitality; used very widely in a literal, accommodated or figurative sense (bodily or mental)
H2506: properly, smoothness (of the tongue); also an allotment
H776: the earth (at large, or partitively a land)
H2416: alive; hence, raw (flesh); fresh (plant, water, year), strong; also (as noun, especially in the feminine singular and masculine plural) life (or living thing), whether literally or figuratively
H7181: to prick up the ears, i.e. hearken
H7440: properly, a creaking (or shrill sound), i.e. shout (of joy or grief)
H3588: (by implication) very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb (as below); often largely modified by other particles annexed
H1809: to slacken or be feeble; figuratively, to be oppressed
H3966: properly, vehemence, i.e. (with or without preposition) vehemently; by implication, wholly, speedily, etc. (often with other words as an intensive or superlative; especially when repeated)
H5337: to snatch away, whether in a good or a bad sense
H7291: to run after (usually with hostile intent; figuratively (of time) gone by)
H553: to be alert, physically (on foot) or mentally (in courage)
H3318: to go (causatively, bring) out, in a great variety of applications, literally and figuratively, direct and proxim.
H4525: a fastener, i.e. (of a person) a smith, (of a thing) a prison
H3034: physically, to throw (a stone, an arrow) at or away; especially to revere or worship (with extended hands); intensively, to bemoan (by wringing the hands)
H853: properly, self (but generally used to point out more definitely the object of a verb or preposition, even or namely)
H8034: an appellation, as amark or memorial of individuality; by implication honor, authority, character
H3803: to enclose; hence (in a friendly sense) to crown, (in a hostile one) to besiege; also to wait (as restraining oneself)
H1580: to treat a person (well or ill), i.e. benefit or requite; by implication (of toil), to ripen, i.e. (specifically) to wean
